name: Tamojit Bera
headline: Prev-SWE & AI Intern @ Attention.ad · Research Assistant, CS @ UMN
about: I build intelligent and secure software that ships. My work spans recommendation systems, vision-based anomaly detection for CPS, and full-stack tooling for simulation and visualization.

bullets: Supervisor: Prof. Maria Gini.
Engineered AI and vision guided object detection models on NVIDIA Jetson to autonomously detect, track, and deter deer from farms.
Integrated real-time detection with automated flight path adjustments for efficient drone navigation.
Awarded ”Excellence in Small Farms Tech” (Air Category) at the Farm Robotics Challenge, 2025
Taught Introduction to Computing and Programming Concepts (CSCI 1133), Advanced Programming Principles (CSCI 2041) and Computational Linear Algebra (CSCI 2033).
Supervised groups of over 200 students, providing academic support and fostering a collaborative learning environment.
Led weekly labs, discussions and office hours, offering personalized assistance and clarification to enhance students’ comprehension of complex concepts
Supervisor: Dr. Animesh Chhotaray
Designed a vision-based anomaly detection pipeline for Directed Energy Deposition (DED) printing.
Spearheaded GenAI-driven recommendation systems for blockchain-based creator platforms.

Gained hands-on experience with Hugging Face Transformers, FastAPI, Docker, and GPT-4 API with LangChain for building and deploying AI models, while also working with Ethereum smart contracts, Solidity, and Web3.js to design creator-economy tools.
Designed algorithms for optimizing static analysis reports for embedded software systems based on MISRA-C guidelines.
Enhanced analysis accuracy by refining detection logic, optimizing safety-critical code assessment.
Developed an Android app gamifying eco-friendly choices, using Java and Kotlin on Android Studio.
Created a template for teammates to work on various screens, ensuring consistent UI and user experience.
Implemented seamless navigation and screen transitions with animated UI elements.
Collaborated using GitHub for version control and Jira for task management.
Led a team of 5 in designing a telemetry module that retrieves data from over 50 sensors in a race car, transmitting data via XBee modules to a server.
Reduced packet loss using Python algorithms, ensuring accurate real-time data transmission.
Developed real-time dashboards with Grafana for analyzing performance data.
Designed and built PCBs to manage key car functionalities.
Designed an Object Detection and Tracking model using OpenCV and DeepSORT to track vehicles at road intersections.
Built a system to identify and intercept traffic rule violations, enhancing road safety through AI-driven solutions.
Supervisor: Prof. Subhash C. Bagui.
Researched techniques for intrusion detection using deep learning.
Implemented a machine learning-based Intrusion Detection System in Python, leveraging the NSL-KDD dataset for training and evaluation.
